audit_items.proof_trace: The collateral-debt exclusivity invariant is enforced by two bi-directional guards: `deposit_ctoken` (L86-89) asserts `!debts.contains(CoinType)` before adding any collateral, and `try_borrow_asset` (L120-124) asserts `!is_supporting_collateral` before adding any debt entry. Crucially, the flash loan functions `borrow_flash_loan` and `repay_flash_loan` operate exclusively on `self.assets` and `self.reserves`, never touching `self.obligations`, so neither relaxes these guards. The `ObligationDebts {}` witness is a private struct accessible only within `obligation.move`, meaning no alternative code path can add entries to `debts` without the collateral check.
